summary: Obama expects AI to bring large benefits and serious disruption, and he calls for government rules rather than voluntary company standards alone.

statements.quote: It’s a really sophisticated, remarkable technology, but it should be thought of as a tool, which means we have choices in terms of how we use this.
I’m not an AI accelerationist who believes it will lead to some techno-utopia, and I’m not a doomer who thinks it will inevitably lead to humanity’s destruction.
At the end of the day, voluntary standards made by a handful of tech companies won’t be enough.
It has enormous potential to jumpstart discovery and innovation at speeds and at levels that we have not seen before, and that could improve everybody’s lives enormously.
I guarantee you you’re going to start seeing shifts in white collar work as a consequence of what these new AI models can do.
